apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Games with no working link are hidden, and Home opens straight away. US games get their real TV channel (ESPN, ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, FS1, ACC/SEC/Big Ten Network). UFC Fight Pass and other channels start quicker and buffer less. Spanish/other-language streams filtered out. Behind the scenes: sites that move can be fixed without an update, a backup copy of the update site, and automatic problem reports (nothing personal)

DaddyLive's channels are back (Fox Sports 501-507, Sky Sports, Sky Sport NZ, TNT, ESPN and hundreds more), with cdnlivetv as an automatic backup on each. English only: no foreign channels in Live TV or on games. Tidier Live TV categories (sport networks, movies, crime, food & lifestyle)
